response.description:
Modernize CLI brings application and database modernization
together as one connected, agentic journey. It assesses application
architecture, dependencies, and cloud readiness while discovering the databases
the application relies on and invoking specialized database skills for
compatibility, migration readiness, and target recommendations. The combined
insights create a coordinated modernization plan spanning application code and
the data layer. You can then use GitHub Copilot to remediate the application
and database changes and validate the workload end to end on Azure,
transforming what were traditionally separate modernization efforts into a
single integrated experience. Learn more.
response.title: Public Preview: AI-powered application and database modernization with Modernize CLI
